notes:
Prospect summary: Cornercase Commerce - small direct-to-consumer retailer focused on niche housewares. Incoming via self-serve sign-up -> trial keys used last week. Primary asks: fast product Q&A on product pages and automated attribute extraction for product catalog ingestion. Interested in Hosted API (self-serve).

Discovery notes (shorthand):
- AE: Maya Thompson; SE: Diego Ramos (intro scheduled).
- Lead from web trial; used sample prompt for Q&A (page-level). Feedback: "answers good but slow at scale when page views spike".
- Catalog: ~28k SKUs, many with sparse metadata. Wants attribute enrichment (materials, dimensions, care) to reduce manual tagging.
- Traffic pattern: normal low concurrency, large spikes during weekly newsletter drops and seasonal promos (peak 200-300 concurrent requests for Q&A).
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for Q&A on product pages; willing to accept slightly higher for enrichment jobs if batch.
- Cost sensitivity: high — runs promotions often; looking for predictable unit costs and burst policy.
- Model preference: open models okay for POC; wants ability to fall back to smaller model during bursts to control cost.
- Security: public cloud okay; only asks for audit logs and basic admin SSO later. No strict residency requirement.

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-02-25: inbound signup, trial API key created, automated welcome email + quickstart sent.
- 2026-02-28: 30m intro call (ff_2026-02-28_0a9c), ran through sample Q&A flows; shared product page examples. Action: SE to review latency profiles.
- 2026-03-02: Cornercase uploaded CSV sample (5k rows) for enrichment; asked for sample output format.
- 2026-03-05: Follow-up email from AE summarizing options (embedding vs. on-the-fly Q&A + caching) — prospect replied with usage spikes details.

POC outline proposed:
- Week 1: run hosted API Q&A endpoint on 500 product pages; measure p50/p95 latency and token costs.
- Week 2: run batch enrichment on 5k SKUs (attribute extraction + normalized fields).
- Metrics: latency, tokens/cost per SKU, extraction F1 vs baseline.
- Success criteria: p95 Q&A <350ms in steady state, enrichment accuracy >85%, cost estimate < $X per 1k queries (TBD).

Open questions / blockers:
- Need clear pricing examples for bursty patterns (daily spikes) — prospect wants scenario-based pricing.
- Wants sample code for prefix/KV caching on product pages.
- Concern about tokenization/cost when product descriptions are long (many SKUs have 1-2 paragraphs).

Next steps (aggressive):
- AE to send tailored pricing scenarios + 1-page caching guide (by 2026-03-07).
- Schedule 30m tech demo with SE (Diego) to walk through integration and burst policies.
- If POC metrics look good, convert to self-serve paid account, then revisit Dedicated for reserved burst capacity next quarter.

Notes/quotes from call:
- "We need answers on product pages to be fast—customers bounce otherwise."
- "If we can auto-fill missing attributes for even 60% of our catalog, ops time drops a ton."

Stubs/links: pricing deck + quickstart in drive:/decks; support ticket SUP-1198 opened to track CSV ingestion formatting.

Overall fit: good early-stage SMB lead. High probability to buy hosted API if pricing for bursts is clear and SE can show caching strategy.
